identity:
Dr Richardson,
Last night, both J99 and V27 approached me with a concern.  As is consistent with NOBLE HORIZON protocol, they have been keeping a dream journal and noticed during the weekly meeting that a few nights ago they had exactly the same dream, down to the smallest details.  You can find the exact details in the weekly report but the gist of it was a giant hand reaching out of the sky and covering the entire Earth and squeezing the Earth until it cracked.  Looking back through previous journals, I found that W88 and P61 had similar dreams within the last week.  I'm still trying to track down if there was a "patient zero", so to speak, and if this is some kind of contagious imagery or there is some other obvious explanation, but in the meantime, I'm baffled.  NOBLE HORIZON visions are usually filtered through the individual psyche of the mathematician, and I have no explanation for why in this case multiple mathematicians would exhibit the exact same manifestation.

I'm going to get to the bottom of this.  We already have bad morale after 947188 and this is not going to help.
John Goldberg
Researcher
